result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with no critical visual bugs. One minor layout issue was identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis indicator, making it appear abruptly cut off rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to ensure truncated text shows an ellipsis, signaling to users that the text is intentionally shortened.
